chapter.verse: Jesu in ama' nungzui sawmlenihte a vaikhakna a man khit ciangin a khuapite uhah thu a hilhcian ding leh a tangko dingin tua mun pan paisuak hi.
Tu-in Khris' nasepnate John in thong sungpan a zak ciangin a nungzuite Jesu' kiangah sawl a,
“Nang pen a hong pai dingpa na hi hiam? Ahihkeileh a dang khat ka lamen lai ding uh hiam?” ci-in dongsak hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute hih bangin dawng hi: “Pai unla na muh na zak uh thute John' kiangah va gen un:
Khuamulote in khua mu, khelbaite lampai, vun natna veite kisiangsak, khuazalote in khua za-in misite thokik a, mizawngte' tungah Lungdamna Thu kitangko hi.
Kei' hangin lungnopmawhna a neilo mi thuphangah ahi hi.”

John' nungzuite a paikhiat ciangin Jesu in mihonpi' kiangah John' thu hih bangin gen hi: “Gamgawtak lakah na pusuahkhiat uh, bang en ding na hi uh hiam? Huih' mut-a kihuang ngiaingiai pumpeng kungte hiam?
Hilo ahihleh bang en dinga pusuakkhia na hi uh hiam? Puannel a silh mipa hiam? En un, puannel silh i cihte kumpi inn sungah om uh hi.
Tua ci lehang bang en dinga pusuakkhia na hi uh hiam? Kamsang hiam? Hi hi, ke'n kong cihin ah kamsang khat sangin lianzaw hi.
Ama' thu hih bangin kigelh hi: ‘En un, nangma' mai ah ka kamtaipa ka sawl a, amah in nang' ma-in na lampi sialkhol ding hi.’
“Maantak kong cihin ah numei' sungpana suakte lakah Baptizepa John sangin a thupizaw kuamah piang nailo hi. Himah taleh vantung kumpigam sunga a neu khat nangawn John sangin thupizaw lai hi.
Baptizepa John' hunlenite-a kipan tu ciangdong vantung kumpigam in ngongtatna tuakkha a, mi ngongtatte in zawhthawh thu tawh lencip uh hi.
A hang pen Kamsang Laibu leh Thukhun Laibu in John' hun ciangdong thu genkhol uh hi.
Na sannop nak uhleh amah pen a nung cianga hong pai ding Elijah ahi hi.
Bil neite in za ta hen.
“Hih khangmite bang tawh ka genteh thei ding hiam? Sumbuktual ah a tu, hih bangin a lawm dangte' tung uhah a kiko, naupangte tawh kibang uh hi:
‘Tamngai kong tum uh a, na laam tuankei uh hi; Tamlawh la kong sak uh a, na kap tuankei uh hi.’
A hang pen John anne lo tuidawn lo-in hong pai ciangin mite in, ‘Amah'n dawilawm nei!’ ci uh hi.

Mihing' Tapa anne tuidawn kawmin hong pai ciangin tua mite mah in, ‘En dih un! Anhai zuhaipa, siahdongte leh mawhneite' lawmpa!’ ci uh hi. Ahi zongin pilna cih pen ama' sepkhiatte tawh a maanna kilang hi.”
Tua ciangin Jesu in ama' bawl nalamdangte' lakah a tamzaw a bawlna khuapite kisik tuanlo uh ahih manin mawhsak thugen kipan a, hih bangin ci hi:

“Chorazin aw, na dahhuaizia! Bethsaida aw, na dahhuaizia! A hang pen note' kianga kibawl nalamdangte Tyre leh Sidon ah kibawl hileh amaute sawtpi pekin kisik khin ding uh a, puanhampi silhin vut kizut khin ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin ke'n kong cihin ah thukhen ni ciangin Tyre leh Sidon in note sangin thuaknop sazaw ding uh hi.

Tua mah bangin Capernaum aw, vantung dong ah nang hong kilaamto ding ahi hiam? Leinuai dong ah hong kikoihsuk ding hizaw hi. A hang pen nang' kianga kibawl nalamdangte Sodom ah kibawl hileh tuni dong tua khua omkip ding hi.
Ahi zongin ke'n kong cihin ah thukhen ni ciangin Sodom gam in note sangin thuaknop sazaw ding hi.”
Tua hun sung mahin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: “Pa aw, vantung leh leitung' Topa nangmah kong pahtawi hi. Mipil thutheite' tungah hih thute na imcip a, naupangnote' tungah na lakkhia hi.
Himah hi, Pa aw, tua pen nangma' deihsakna ahi hi.
Ka Pa in na khempeuh kei' tungah hong ap khinzo hi. Pa simloh Tapa a thei kuamah om lo a, Tapa leh Tapa' theihsak mite simloh Pa a thei kuamah om lo hi.
Thazawmin vangik a lelte khempeuh aw, ka kiangah hong pai un. Tawldamna kong pia ding hi.
Ka hakkol kisuan unla kei' kiangah hong sin un. Kei nunnemin lungsim kiniamkhiat ka hih manin na nunna kha uh' adingin tawldamna na ngah ding uh hi.
A hang pen ka hakkol puaknuamin ka van zong zang ahih man hi.”
